pages.title: Schomburgk's Deer
pages.text: Schomburgk's deer ($(o)Rucervus schomburgki$()) is an extinct deer that lived on the swampy, grassy plains of the Chao Phraya River valley in central Thailand.$(br2)Males grew striking basket-like antlers with many branching tines, while females had none.$(br2)It was driven to extinction by hunting and by the conversion of its swamps to rice fields; the last wild deer was killed by 1932, and the last captive one in 1938.
